description: This file defines a C# class implementing a transactional grain with fault injection capabilities for Orleans, including an interface for testing and a class with methods for setting, adding, retrieving, and deactivating grain state.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionTestGrain
classes.description: Interface defining transactional grain methods for setting, adding, getting values, and deactivating the grain.

classes.name: SingleStateFaultInjectionTransactionalGrain
classes.description: Implementation of a transactional grain with fault injection capabilities, managing grain state and logging.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous activation method initializing the logger and logging the grain ID.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a new value in the grain's state.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified number to the grain's state, with optional fault injection control.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value from the grain's state.
